dct_description_sm: The data presented in this paper is from a larger project assessing the effect of feeding omega-3 fatty acids to layer breeder hens on the behaviour of their offspring. This paper aims to demonstrate the effect of maternal-fed omega-3 fatty acids on the associative learning ability of two strains of layer chickens (ISA Brown and Shaver White).
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Strain and age but not maternal feeding of n-3 fatty acids affect the performance of laying hen offspring in a series of associative learning tasks
